texts.title: The world's most valuable telemedicine companies, ranked by AI | Uback
texts.description: Uback ranks the world's non-listed telemedicine companies by AI-estimated valuation: Ro, Sword Health, Transcarent, eMed, Included Health and more. Edition 0 (beta).
texts.h1: The world’s most valuable telemedicine companies
texts.intro: Virtual-first care providers whose main activity is online consultations and virtual primary or specialty care, from generalist telehealth to digital physiotherapy and obesity care. Ranked worldwide by AI-estimated valuation. The market sets the value; our AI estimates it.
texts.not_in_segment: Appointment booking, online pharmacy, mental health (including teletherapy), women's health (including women's telehealth) and connected devices each have their own segment. A company appears in one segment only.
texts.activity: virtual-first consultations and virtual primary and specialty care
texts.sources: TechCrunch, MobiHealthNews, Fierce Healthcare, Healthcare Dive, Bloomberg Tax, Sacra, Forge Global, Caproasia, ChinaVenture, DealStreetAsia, Stock Analysis, Halle Tecco, company announcements.

ranked.name: Ro

last_equity_round.investors: led by ShawSpring Partners, with General Catalyst, FirstMark Capital, TQ Ventures

ranked.note_internal: 2022 mark at $7B is stale; revenue ~$598M in 2024 (+66%, Sacra) driven by GLP-1s, likely higher in 2025. Discounted vs peak given DTC telehealth multiples (Hims) and GLP-1 pricing risk.

ranked.name: Sword Health
ranked.note_internal: Founded in Portugal, HQ New York, revenue mostly US employers. $240M run rate, cash-flow positive at the $4B mark; virtual physiotherapy (digital MSK) counted as virtual-first specialty care.

ranked.name: Transcarent

last_equity_round.amount_label: amount not disclosed (preferred stock financing the Accolade deal)
last_equity_round.investors: led by General Catalyst and 62 Ventures

ranked.note_internal: $2.2B at May 2024 Series D, then equity-financed acquisition of Accolade ($621M equity value, closed Apr 2025). Navigation + virtual care + pharmacy platform for employers; check boundary.

reach.value_text: 20M+ members; 1,700+ employer and health plan clients

ranked.name: eMed

last_equity_round.investors: led by Aon Consulting, with Tom Brady, Joe Lonsdale, Antonio Gracias

ranked.note_internal: Fresh March 2026 mark ('over $2B'); employer GLP-1 telehealth programs. Revenue undisclosed, so kept at the mark.

ranked.name: Included Health

published_valuation.label: USD 1.13B (Grand Rounds, before merger with Doctor On Demand)

ranked.note_internal: Grand Rounds $1.13B (2020) + Doctor On Demand merged 2021; no combined valuation published. Acquiring Firefly Health (closing Q3 2026). Estimate is scale-based, low confidence.

reach.value_text: Tens of millions of members; 300+ employer and health plan clients

ranked.name: WeDoctor

last_equity_round.investors: Tencent-backed; investors include HongShan, Hermitage Capital, CICCFH, Qiming, AIA

ranked.note_internal: 2022 mark ~$6.7-7B looks inflated: revenue RMB 1.86B in 2023 (~$260M), RMB 1.82B in H1 2024, still loss-making; several Hong Kong IPO filings lapsed. Heavy discount; listing status to re-check.

ranked.name: Virta Health
ranked.note_internal: 2021 mark at $2B; revenue ~$158M annualized in Aug 2025 (+80% YoY, Sacra), IPO talk for 2026. Virtual diabetes and obesity care.

ranked.name: Kry (Livi)

last_equity_round.investors: led by Teachers' Venture Growth and P Capital Partners

ranked.note_internal: 2021 peak mark $2B; 2024 revenue SEK 2.5B (~$240M), EBITDA -4.4%, first operating profit reported in 2025. Mixed virtual/physical European model, ~3x revenue.

ranked.name: Halodoc

last_equity_round.amount_label: USD 100M (USD 135M Series D in total per Novo Holdings)
last_equity_round.investors: led by Astra International, with Openspace and Novo Holdings

ranked.note_internal: Valuation never disclosed; estimate inferred from the $100-135M Series D (post-money ≈ round / 0.2) and leading position in Indonesian telehealth.

ranked.name: Doctor Anywhere

last_equity_round.investors: led by Asia Partners and Novo Holdings

ranked.note_internal: Valuation never disclosed; estimate from 2021 Series C size, discounted for age. No later round found; operates across SEA (SG, VN, TH, MY, PH).

listed_benchmarks.name: Ping An Good Doctor (Ping An Healthcare and Technology)
